task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact details and verify her employee record, then check for meeting rooms for 6 people at 2:00 PM on 2025-09-15 and schedule a “Quarterly Planning Sync” from 2:00 to 3:00 PM with Alice and Bob. After that, send Alice a high-priority app alert that the meeting has been scheduled and the room is being prepared, then scan the living room devices, identify the smart lock, check the living room light’s status, turn that light on, set its brightness to 70%, and finally create a snapshot of `/shared/meeting-prep` named `meeting_prep_snapshot` and send Alice a high-priority app notification.

user_input.query: Please look up alice’s contact details and verify her employee record, then check for a meeting room for at least 6 people at 14:00 on 2025-09-15 and schedule “Quarterly Planning Sync” from 2025-09-15 14:00 to 2025-09-15 15:00 with alice@company.com and bob@company.com. After that, send Alice a high-priority app alert saying, “Your meeting has been scheduled and the room is being prepared.” Then scan the living_room devices, identify the smart lock, check the status of the light with device ID light_living, turn that light on, and set its brightness to 70%. Finally, create a snapshot of /shared/meeting-prep named meeting_prep_snapshot and send Alice a high-priority app notification.
